$schema_note: S-ENVTRUTH (2026-10-01). Every EXPO_PUBLIC_* name the app reads. kind: required (release build must set it), optional (has a working default), flag (boolean feature/mock switch). default: what the code does when unset. Enforced by scripts/__tests__/expectedEnv.test.js. easSideCredentials lists credentials that live in EAS (not env vars, never read by app code) so they are not mistaken for missing keys.

easSideCredentials.where: EAS credentials for the Android app (eas credentials -> Android -> Google Service Account Key for Push Notifications (FCM V1))
easSideCredentials.reason: Android push delivery depends on it (operator 2026-10-01; mobile PR #318 swaps google-services.json to this Firebase project). Not an environment variable: nothing in app code reads it.

releaseProfiles.$note: Pre-build release-env check (scripts/check-expected-env.js --release-env; EAS runs it as the eas-build-pre-install hook with EAS_BUILD_PROFILE). For a listed profile it checks, without printing values: every kind:required name plus `require` is set and not a placeholder (format-checked: https URLs on a real host, a Supabase anon key whose JWT role is anon, a Sentry DSN, a Stripe publishable key of the given mode); every eas.json build.<profile>.env value (after extends) reaches the build unchanged; no secret-shaped EXPO_PUBLIC_* is set. Profiles not listed here (development) are skipped.

clinic.reason: Clinic store binary: crash and unknown-error reporting must work (owner rule), and real clients pay.

preview.reason: Internal APK/TestFlight test builds: required names and placeholders only; Stripe test keys allowed.
